description: Points d'arrêt des réseaux de transport RTM (Régie des Transports de Marseille) is a dataset listed in DATA Métropole Aix-Marseille Provence open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Métropole Aix-Marseille Provence. Le jeu de données 'Points d'arrêt des réseaux de transport' est un fichier GTFS stops qui répertorie les points d'arrêt associées au réseau de transport RTM (Régie des Transports de Marseille), qui dessert les communes de Marseille, Allauch, et Plan-de-Cuques. Coverage: Aix-Marseille-Provence Metropolis. The portal files it under Transports. Its keywords are transport, rtm, Mobilité, stops, Deplacement. The portal shows 2,750 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2024-06-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-ampmetropole-fr-portal.
